_comment: Microsoft Graph application permissions required by the Work IQ Entra app (app-only). Grant + admin-consent these on the app registration whose id is ENTRA_GRAPH_APP_ID. Modelled on Lulu IQ's infra/entra-graph-permissions.json.

applicationPermissions.reason: Read the SharePoint document library that holds per-borrower loan folders.
List the files in each borrower's folder to compute received/missing documents.

notes: Store the app client secret in Key Vault under the name in ENTRA_GRAPH_APP_SECRET_KV_SECRET (default 'entra-graph-app-secret'). The Container App's managed identity reads it at runtime via DefaultAzureCredential; the secret value never lands in env.
